Zarnovica New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Za kalváriou, Slovakia

Not demolished. Little further historical information is documented about the Jewish community of Žarnovica beyond this, the town's newer Jewish cemetery, which sits on land belonging to the Roman Catholic church. According to a local council worker, youth use the site for drinking and drug use, and while the council contacted the Jewish community in Banská Bystrica about building a protective wall, no progress has been made — the council itself lacks authority to act, since it does not own the land.
